input.prompt: Create one photorealistic16:9 WHAT IT COST documentary editorial frame, matching the supplied REAL VIDEO008 scene references in natural materials, camera scale and neutral soft window light. References are STYLE ONLY, never copy their Anthropic text or figures. Ordinary contemporary charcoal pebbled desktop, clean lightly handled ivory paper and simple stationery. NO rusty machines, counters, pedestals, giant floating headlines, brass stage props, dust beams, fantasy lighting, empty sheets, pseudo-writing or collage. Type belongs naturally on meaningful printed analytical paper, normal black serif report typography, NOT huge poster signs. These are our original documentary EDITORIAL ANALYSIS sheets, never authentic Fyre/DOJ/SEC/company records. The small page heading must say EDITORIAL ANALYSIS; no official seal, letterhead, signature, account number, fake quote or source facsimile. Print only requested verified text; no invented rows, values, monthly distribution or financial instrument. No red/yellow ink, highlights, borders, callouts, circles, underlines or motion. Simple normal black table rules are allowed. All meaningful text in upper75%, bottom20%free of important content for later separate Fusion layers. One continuous realistic shot, no overlaid banner. Only the requested subject props, no devices or UI, no money/coins/tickets unless explicitly requested. A realistic printed editorial scrutiny note on a small ivory landscape sheet, tucked naturally over the edge of a narrow folder on charcoal; a normal pencil and two small paper clips for scale. Text only: 'EDITORIAL ANALYSIS'; 'Publicity Is Not Transaction Evidence'; 'Publicity: attention and promotion.'; 'Verification: evidence of completed business.'; 'Question: was the transaction independently confirmed?'. No completed checkbox or claim the company passed verification, no actual investor meeting, fake source quotation, physical stage spotlight or giant engraved display. Normal black serif document typography, understated natural window light, no red ink.
